text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While out with Curren Bouquetd'or, we 
stopped by a park with a large flowerbed.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—A gentle fragrance of flowers drifts on 
the breeze. It really is a wonderful 
place.

text_block_list.name: Girl's Voice
text_block_list.text: "...No! I don't wanna go home!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ...Is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Girl's Mother
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm sorry. This child is currently 
hospitalized... She's out on a temporary 
pass today, but she doesn't seem to want 
to go back to the hospital—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ...It's tough, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text:
"...I don't want to go to the hospital 
anymore. The walls, the ceiling, the 
smell... Everything feels so cold."

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text:
...I want to stay here forever. Because 
it's so pretty here...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...Um. If it wouldn't be a bother— I 
have—a suggestion.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And after getting permission from the 
parents and the doctor at the hospital, 
Curren Bouquetd'or made a certain 
"arrangement."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"...Thank you for waiting. Now then... 
please, step inside the room."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Right there—was a hospital room completely 
decorated with flower arrangements made by 
Curren Bouquetd'or.

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: ...So pretty...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I apologize for being so forward. I just 
hope... that this brings you joy.

text_block_list.name: Girl's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Not at all! Just look at their face! Ever 
since they were hospitalized, they've 
never smiled like that...!

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Big Sis! What kind of flower is 
this!?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... That is—an alstroemeria. And that 
one over there is a gerbera—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"Thank goodness... I'm so glad... she 
liked it."
choice_data_list: That was a wonderful idea, so like you.

That was a wonderful idea, so very like 
you.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"...I just remembered something from the 
past. When I was a child, I used to visit 
my father's hospital often, and—"

text_block_list.name: Young Bouquet
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, mister. Why are you always staring 
out the window like that?

text_block_list.name: Inpatient
text_block_list.text:
"...Now then—I wonder why. Before I know 
it, my eyes always wander over there—"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—Many of the patients yearned for the 
outside world. Not a closed world like a 
hospital room—but a free one.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"I wanted to do something to help, but... 
On my own, I just didn't know what to do."

text_block_list.name: Young Bouquet
text_block_list.text:
Father... Is there anything— anything that 
I can do?

text_block_list.name: Bouquet's Father
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. At times like that— putting yourself 
in their shoes might be a good place to 
start.

text_block_list.name: Bouquet's Father
text_block_list.text:
For example, if Bouquet were one of the 
patients. What kind of thing do you think 
would bring comfort to her heart?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
And what I came up with... was decorating 
the entire hospital with lots of flowers.

text_block_list.name: Inpatient
text_block_list.text:
...It's beautiful. ............I feel like 
it's reminded me of something I had 
forgotten for a long time.

text_block_list.name: Inpatient
text_block_list.text:
The smell of flowers is the smell of life, 
huh. ...I truly believe that from the 
bottom of my heart.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
It was so strange. The scent of the 
flowers seemed to breathe life back into 
the patients' faces... and it warmed my 
heart, too.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
That's when I asked my dad. What am I 
supposed to call... a feeling like this?

text_block_list.name: Bouquet's Father
text_block_list.text:
—Illness always brings forth unpleasant 
feelings. Anxiety. Fear. Pain... 
Unpleasant waves like that always stir 
within a patient's heart.

text_block_list.name: Bouquet's Father
text_block_list.text:
Yet—right now, everyone's hearts are at 
peace. Gentle, alongside the flowers. 
...What the bouquet is feeling is... 
surely—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ……"Harmony".

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
The first time I learned that word —was 
back then.
choice_data_list:
Those words became very important to you, 
didn't they?

Those words have become very precious to 
you, haven't they?

Flowers really do have that kind of power, 
huh.

Flowers really do have that kind of power, 
don't they?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
The first time I learned that word —was 
back then.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Yes. They were brief words, but... like a 
beautiful, single flower... they resonated 
deep within my heart.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
No matter how many seasons pass... A 
flower that will never wither. A flower 
like that—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I've always loved flowers. Beautiful, 
lovely—wonderful things. But I realized 
they're not just that.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"She gives us comfort and courage... A 
truly kind, and dependable presence."
